body:
When a send to a worker returns notificationDisposition durableButNotWoken (or heldBehindPausedQueue), immediately GET /api/sessions/{id}. If it reads queuePaused=true with pending prompts and the session is idle, POST /api/sessions/{id}/queue/resume, then read back; the turn may take a second to begin. Since 2026-10-16 queues have been seen paused at ORDINARY turn ends with no stop (Coder 7422 at 23:07Z on build 12e16176), so a worker can idle forever otherwise. Record each occurrence on w-80e0cb2002da.

UPDATE 2026-10-17 05:51Z: if /queue/resume returns 200 but the queue STAYS paused, read the session preview. "Waiting/Unknown after interrupted authorization ... cancel or reconcile" means an Engram admission timed out (for example a 20 s deadline) and the head prompt is interrupted, so resume won't release it. If the head is only a mailbox NOTIFICATION, cancel it with POST /api/sessions/{id}/queued-prompts/{headId}/cancel and then resume. The mailbox message stays durable, so tell the session to re-read that mailbox. Don't cancel a head that carries real user work without its owner's say.
